record.t: Took activist Keandra McDole to Chancery Court over her protests outside Department of Justice employees' homes.
record.q: McDole had been protesting outside Department of Justice employees’ homes after two Delaware police officers who killed a black man were cleared of wrongdoing in early 2021. Jennings took her to the Chancery to try to limit her ability to protest.
